note: Retrieval-ceiling probes: no LLM, no API key, no cost. Each probe asks which functions call a symbol, and scores what each arm's TOOLS surface against the same hand-verified gold set used by the agent protocol (alias-v4.json). This measures the upper bound on agent accuracy — a caller absent from every tool response cannot be named by any model — not agent accuracy itself. Gold sets are checked against alias-v4.json's keys by TestCeilingProbesMatchTheAnswerKeys; they cannot drift silently.
